_comment: Payoff table tuned so a false positive actually costs something.
With the default table a wrong LOG_ALERT on benign traffic costs -0.05
while a correct one on an attack pays +0.20, so alerting on everything
scores almost as well as being right -- training wandered between a 1%
and a 96% false-positive rate with no change in reward. Here every
action on benign traffic costs about four times more, while the
detection payoffs are unchanged, so precision has to be earned.
Rows = ALLOW, LOG_ALERT, RATE_LIMIT, BLOCK_SRC, ISOLATE_HOST, DECEIVE.
Columns = BENIGN, RECON, DOS, C2, OTHER_MALICIOUS.
